## What's Changed - Bump build number for TestFlight/Sparkle (marketing version unchanged) - Fix refresh CPU spike: batch the per-podcast unplayed-count fetch - updated TODO
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geoffoliver/podstash/compare/v0.0.21-1...v0.0.21-2

## What's Changed - Bump build number for TestFlight (marketing version unchanged) - Float the transport bar like Apple Podcasts, fix bugs found along the way - Redesign iOS Now Playing to mirror Apple Podcasts, simplify compact bar - Add tap-to-toggle time remaining on the elapsed playback label - Add ability to unsubscribe from Search Podcasts dialog - tweaked TODO - Add iOS Settings Done button; widen Unplayed/Queue eligibility - Mark video playback support TODO item complete - Enable Sparkle's Installer Launcher XPC service in Info.plist - Add video download settings: Wi-Fi-only gating and auto-download opt-in (Phase 6) - Fix video badge overflowing small episode thumbnails - Fix Storage row showing 0 MB for a downloaded episode with no measured duration - Add iOS inline video playback with Audio/Video toggle (Phase 5) - Add macOS video window (Phase 4 of VIDEO_PLAYBACK_PLAN.md) - Add shared EpisodeThumbnail view (Phase 3 of VIDEO_PLAYBACK_PLAN.md) - Add video playback core (Phase 2 of VIDEO_PLAYBACK_PLAN.md) - Fix crash from duplicate episodeKey when building the queue lookup - Mark video playback Phase 1 (feed parsing) done in TODO - Lay groundwork for video playback support (Phase 1) - Bump build number to 3 for TestFlight - Fix swipe-to-unsubscribe navigating to detail view instead of confirming - UI improvements - search button on keyboard for searching podcasts - little ui tweaks - Apply Xcode's recommended project settings - Fix build warnings before release - Bump build number to 2 for TestFlight - Add iTunes podcast search to iOS "+" menu
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geoffoliver/podstash/compare/v0.0.21...v0.0.21-1

## What's Changed - Bump to 0.0.21 - Add Tier 3 tests: subscribe/unsubscribe and download-pruning cutoffs - Extract PlaybackProgressPolicy and add regression tests for d300731 - Add Tier 1 tests: episode retention cleanup and feed-refresh matching - Add PodstashTests target with parser and playback-record-store tests - fixed issue with episodes disappearing from queue - Update iOS launch screen icon to match the new app icon
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geoffoliver/podstash/compare/v0.0.20...v0.0.21
